text: After the philosophical idea of the unconscious, in the form presented chiefly by Carus and von Hartmann, had gone down under the overwhelming wave of materialism and empiricism, leaving hardly a ripple behind it, it gradually reappeared in the scientific domain of medical psychology.

down under the overwhelming wave of materialism and empiricism,
leaving hardly a ripple behind it, it gradually reappeared in the scientific
domain of medical psychology.
